audit.whatIsWrong: diff says HARD but diffRating is 4/10, the tone is the favoured green, report[14] says 'Favoured matchup', report[2] says 'Yours from level 1' and report[7] says 'convert the favoured lane into kills' — while the win rate is 48.08% and Malphite owns four of seven chart rows.
audit.why: This is the only matchup in the slice Quinn loses. Levels 1-2 are hers; from his first armour item onward the physical kit stops working, which the prose already says plainly.
audit.corrected: diffRating to 7/10, with breakdown.difficulty, report[2].t, report[7].t and report[14].t reworded to stop advertising a favoured lane. diff already reads HARD and is left.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 read Skill, Level 3 read Malphite and Level 6 read Quinn — the last of which directly contradicts its own caption, 'his unstoppable R ignores my blind and E entirely — once it's online he owns every all-in'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Malphite, Malphite, Malphite, Malphite, and the audited mirror states the same seven sides. whys[1] describes Quinn dodging his Q and out-tempoing him; whys[2] explicitly calls level 3 'a wash — neither kills'.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Quinn, row 2 to Skill, row 4 to Malphite, in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction is absent: Seismic Shard and Ground Slam both ground, so Vault cannot dash you out of his engage. Also missing is what survives the blind — Thunderclap's aftershocks stop with his autos, Ground Slam does not.
audit.why: Kit: Q flagged grounding, 8s flat, 625 range; E flagged grounding, 7s flat; R 130s at rank 1, 1000 range, dash plus knockup. A blind stops basic attacks only, and Thunderclap works through his attacks while Ground Slam is a spell. Both points are in missingInteractions (dash-denied) and the mirror.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d now state the grounding, the real cooldowns, and exactly what the blind does and does not stop.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Un-dodgeable burst. Vault/dodge it.' contradicts itself and carries no number.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s; Seismic Shard a flat 8s; Ground Slam a flat 7s.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the correct advice (do not line up for it) written into the cooldown block, the do's and report[5].
